sentences.text:
Ms. Seema Jaiswal- Panel Lawyer for respondent/State.
 ORDER
In pursuance to the order dated 13.11.2024, a report is submitted by the police concerned, which reveals that the appellant has died on 24.02.2024.
The relevant documents are also annexed with the report.

The present appeal has been filed being aggrieved by the judgment dated 11.01.1999 passed in S.T.
No.308/1998 by the learned Additional Sessions Judge, Sagar, whereby the appellant has been convicted for the offence punishable under Section 376 of IPC and sentenced to undergo R.I. for seven years with fine of Rs.500/- with default stipulation.
None of the relatives of the appellant has applied for leave to continue the appeal, therefore, the appeal is dismissed as abated as per the provisions of Section 394(1) of Cr.P.C.
(RAMKUMAR CHOUBEY) JUDGE SS NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:55953 2 CRA-153-1999 Paramlal vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/134803437/
